title: Nutty Greek Dill Pickles Gratin
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring dill pickles, soffritto-base, and a crunchy topping.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the contents of the dill pickle jar to the saucepan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Transfer the pickle mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese, chopped fresh dill, and chopped walnuts over the top of the pickle mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
